name: neuromfe-lab
description: Simulación educativa de Brain Computer Interface con Micro Frontends

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shell,body,brain,signal,decoder -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow,blue "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/shell dev" "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/body-mfe dev" "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/brain-mfe dev" "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/signal-mfe dev" "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/decoder-mfe dev"
scripts.validate: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n shell,body,brain,signal,decoder -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow,blue "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/shell preview" "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/body-mfe preview" "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/brain-mfe preview" "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/signal-mfe preview" "pnpm --filter @neuromfe/decoder-mfe preview"
